title: Run Fetch + Summarize to Populate Board

rootCauseHypotheses: CONFIRMED CODE BUG: The board.py filter uses WHERE date(last_seen_at)=today, which is too aggressive. Even with window_days=30 set by the user in the UI, repos are invisible unless fetch ran *today*. The fix should replace the today-gate with a window_days-based cutoff (last_seen_at >= now - window_days).
Fetch timer (github-digest-fetch.timer) last ran 2026-02-21 12:00 UTC; next run is 2026-02-22 08:00 UTC. Until then, the today-gate blocks all 62 repos regardless of window_days setting.

Radar /today empty: daily_picks has 7 rows for 2026-02-21 but /api/today queries date('now')=2026-02-22. Radar pipeline (ingest-hn, rank-daily) has no scheduled job — must be run manually or added to cron.
github-digest-summarize.timer also exists (last ran 04:00 UTC today) but no radar pipeline timer exists.
